profile.role_note: A healer and support. She enables both Tune Rupture and Tune Strain teams.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Pull Mornye if you want the top Fusion support. Her Off-Tune speed-up and All DMG buffs grow in value as more Tune Shifting characters release.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Starfield Calibrator (or Discord) + 5-piece Halo of Starry Radiance in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Reactor Husk in the main slot. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, DEF% 1-costs, and 260% Energy Regen, so her Interfered Marker and Critical Protocol fully activate.

ranked_weapons.name: Starfield Calibrator
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. DEF%, Concerto Energy on skill, and team Crit DMG when she heals. Best in slot.

ranked_weapons.name: Discord
ranked_weapons.note: An affordable 4-star with lots of Energy Regen and Concerto Energy. Her signature at S1 beats it, but Discord is fine.

ranked_weapons.name: Dauntless Evernight
ranked_weapons.note: ATK and DEF on Intro. A solid stat stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Broadblade#41
ranked_weapons.note: An ATK buff at high HP. An accessible filler.

ranked_weapons.name: Originite: Type I
ranked_weapons.note: It heals on Resonance Skill. A budget comfort pick.

echo_sets.name: Halo of Starry Radiance
echo_sets.note: The 3.0 healer set. Its team ATK buffs scale with Off-Tune Buildup Rate, and it adds extra healing. It was made for her.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: The same healing and team ATK buffs, with roughly 10% less ATK increase than Halo. Fully workable while you farm.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus. Her buffs and healing scale off it.
Energy Regen on both 3-costs. 260% total is the target.
DEF% on both. Her healing scales with DEF.

teams.name: Premium: Aemeath + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Aemeath
members.note: Fusion hypercarry; Tune Rupture mode benefits from Mornye's Off-Tune buffs.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Universal Liberation amplifier with heavy All-DMG buffs; pairs with Mornye's Off-Tune support.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Heals, boosts Off-Tune Buildup Rate, and amplifies All DMG for both teammates.

teams.rotation: Mornye opens: three Basic Attacks, then hold Heavy Attack to enter Wide Field Observation Mode. Use her skill into Liberation to set up High Syntony Field, then swap out to Lynae. Lynae buffs, then swaps out into Aemeath's Liberation combo for the big damage window.

teams.name: Alternative: Jingran + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Jingran
members.note: HP-scaling Fusion heavy-attack carry; Mono Fusion keeps Lupa-style buffs live.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: All-DMG and Liberation amplification for Jingran's burst windows.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: General All-DMG buffs, faster Tune Breaks, and sustain.

teams.rotation: Mornye runs her field-observation opener into Lynae's buff window. Then Jingran enters through his Intro: Liberation into loops of enhanced Heavy Attacks. He swaps back to Mornye at full Concerto.

sequences.verdict: S0 is already a complete support. Aim for S1: it guarantees the 40% team debuff. S2 adds team Crit DMG. S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Her full kit: a 25% team DMG boost, healing, and debuff potential.
It guarantees the 40% team debuff without a Tune partner. Her best dupe.
Up to 32% Crit DMG for the team, from her Energy Regen stacking.
A Liberation burst build. Whale territory.

nodes.name: The Silent Observer
nodes.effect: Interfered Marker needs no Tune setup first and lasts 150% longer. Her key attacks gain interruption immunity.

nodes.name: Morning Star of Entropy
nodes.effect: The team gains up to 32% Crit DMG against Interfered targets, scaling with her Energy Regen. Fields also give +20% Off-Tune buildup.

nodes.name: Blueprint of Recursion
nodes.effect: Distributed Array restores 25 Concerto Energy and 100 Relative Momentum every 25s.

nodes.name: Latent Variables of the Cosmos
nodes.effect: High Syntony Field healing +30%. Healing only, with low damage impact.

nodes.name: Time Dilation Effect
nodes.effect: Liberation multiplier +40% and Particle Jet multiplier +160%. Personal damage only.

nodes.name: To the Far Shores of the Stars
nodes.effect: Her Liberation deals 400% more DMG. She also gains a slow trickle of Resonance Energy out of combat.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Signature Starfield Calibrator before dupes for most — but S1 wins on raw DPS value.
